hypotheses.construction_plan: Start from the two-argument template K(x, y); specialize the parameter pair (x, y) to (n, m) to obtain the off-diagonal branch and to (n, n) to obtain the diagonal branch. The original Piecewise expression is the conditional combination of these two specializations under the condition Ne(n, m).
required_assumptions: K is a binary function accepting symbolic arguments x and y
hypotheses.rationale: The observed SAME_FUNCTION_FAMILY relation is structural: both branch expressions use the same function K and differ only by assignment of the two arguments. No algebraic rewrite, derivative, or physical interpretation is needed.
